title: %irr — internal rate of return
purpose: Find the discount rate that makes the net present value of a cash-flow series zero.
notes: Solved by Newton–Raphson from a default 10% guess; the result is the per-period rate as a fraction.
Needs at least two cash flows; an optional second argument overrides the initial guess.
Series with no sign change, or that fail to converge, yield ~ (null).
